entities.summary: Juan Ignacio Brex is an Italian-Argentine professional rugby union player who primarily plays centre for Toulon of the French Top 14. He has also represented Italy at international level. Brex has previously played for clubs such as San Cirano, Pampas XV, and Viadana in the past. He played with Benetton in the United Rugby Championship until 2025.
